# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.10 (pre-release)

Changes since pre.9. Command-line; the window is unchanged.

**Fixes**
- Windows: the program no longer overflows the 1 MB main-thread stack at start (found by CI after pre.9; the pre.9 Windows binary was never started by hand).

**Signing and archive**
- `--sign-pdf` (incremental update, CAdES detached signature, openssl) and `--verify-pdf-signatures`.
- `--timestamp` / `--tsa-url` / `--timestamp-verify` (RFC 3161).
- `--archive-package DIR`: reprocessable folder (originals, project, OCR words with confidence, hashes, how to re-run).
- `--tagged [LANG]`: tagged PDF with paragraph structure from OCR lines and a language; checked with veraPDF on a PDF/A-2b sample; not a PDF/UA claim.
- `--djvu FILE`: bundled DjVu (lossless JB2 for black & white, layered JB2 + IW44 for colour, OCR text layer); accepted by DjVuLibre, black & white decodes to identical pixels.

**Input safety and scale**
- `--isolate-decoders`: each input decoded in a limited worker process (not a security sandbox).
- Memory-mapped PDF input (960 MB test PDF: 1044 MB -> 137 MB peak).
- `--shard I/N` to split a big batch across machines.
- `--plugin FILE.wasm`: image-filter plugins in WebAssembly (no imports, instruction budget, memory cap).

**Checks and phone**
- `--verify-document` (QR contents, copied regions; hints only), `--mrz` (ICAO 9303 check digits), `--fuse-frames` (multi-photo merge; helps only with strong noise).
- Four more domain profiles; documentation by task with a checker, Romanian translations; packaging recipes (AUR, Homebrew, winget, Flatpak, Debian) that have not been submitted.
- `legatorocr-wasm` (cleaning core as a `.wasm`, run in Node on CI) and `web/capture.html` (phone capture page; run in Chromium with a fake camera on CI).

**Tested and not shipped**: ELA for tamper detection, a gate on Oglinda residuals (AUC 0.68).

Not solved: no hand-verified reference text; no real-phone test of the capture page (sharpness threshold untuned); the DjVu and signing outputs are checked with one other reader each; Windows/macOS builds are CI-only; GUI untested on Windows/macOS; package recipes unsubmitted; FADGI tables and a public TSA contract are open.
